_comment: JSON Resume data, loaded by jekyll-get-json (see jekyll_get_json in _config.yml).
The CV page uses cv_format: rendercv and reads _data/cv.yml instead, so this file
exists only to give the jekyll_get_json step something valid to load.
This file is served publicly: no home address, no personal phone number.
The email address is deliberately absent: _data/socials.yml holds the single copy
for the whole site. The address is tied to the current post and will change on a
move, so it is kept in one place only.
